verses.en: Now it came to pass, when Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them;
verses.sm: Kanana e toalima Ua lagona e Atonesateko le tupu o Ierusalema ua aea e Iosua o Ai, ma ua faaumatia e ia; e pei ona faia e ia i Ieriko ma lona tupu, ua faapea lava ona faia e ia ¡Ai ma lona tupu ; ma ua faalelei ma Isaraelu e ua nonofo i Kipeona, ma latou faatasi ma i latou;

verses.en: That they feared greatly, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all the men thereof were mighty.
verses.sm: ona latou matuā fefefe ai lea, aua o le aai tele lava Kipeona, e pei o se aai o se tupu; ana foi e sili ia i Ai, o ona tagata uma foi e totoa i latou.

verses.en: Wherefore Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron, and unto Piram king of Jarmuth, and unto Japhia king of Lachish, and unto Debir king of Eglon, saying,
verses.sm: Ona alu ai lea o le feau a Atonesateko le tupu o lerusalema ia Oama le tupu o Heperona, ma Pirama le tupu o Iaremuta, ma Ta6a le tupu o Lakisa, ma Tiperi le tupu o Ekelona, ua faapea atu,

verses.en: Come up unto me, and help me, that we may smite Gibeon: for it hath made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.
verses.sm: O mai ia ia te au, ma fesoasoani mai ia te au e fasi ia Kipeona; auā ua faalelei i latou ma Iosua atoa ma le fanauga a Isaraelu.

verses.en: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together, and went up, they and all their hosts, and encamped before Gibeon, and made war against it.
verses.sm: Ona faapotopoto ai lea o tupu e toalima o sa Amori, o le tupu o Ierusalema, o le tupu o Heperona, o le tupu o Iaremuta, o le tupu o Lakisa, o le tupu o Ekelona, ma latou o ae, o i latou, ma a latou ‘au uma, ona latou to lauapi ai lea i Kipeona, ma latou tau ma ia.

verses.en: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal, saying, Slack not thy hand from thy servants; come up to us quickly, and save us, and help us: for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us.
verses.sm: Ona alu lea o le feau a tagata o Kipeona ia Iosua i le toagālauapi i Kilikala, ua faapea atu, Aua e te lafoaiina au auauna; ia e faataalise ona alu ae ia te i matou, ma faaolaina i matou, ma fesoasoani ia te i matou; aua ua faapotopotoina e tau ma i matou O tupu uma o sa Amori, o e nonofo i le atu mauga.

verses.en: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.
verses.sm: Ona alu ae lea o Iosua nai Kilikala, o ia ma “au uma o le taua faatasi ma ia, atoa ma toa malolosi uma.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Fear them not: for I have delivered them into thine hand; there shall not a man of them stand before thee.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai Mai lea o le Att ja Iosua, Ana e te fefe ia te i latou, aua ua ou tuuina atu i latou i ou lima; e leai so latou e tu i ou luma.

verses.en: Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly, and went up from Gilgal all night.
verses.sm: Ua oo faafuasei Iosua ia te i latou; na atoa le po o alu ae ia nai Kilikala.

verses.en: And the LORD discomfited them before Israel, and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the way that goeth up to Beth-horon, and smote them to Azekah, and unto Makkedah.
verses.sm: Ona tulia lea o i latou e le Arr i luma o Isaraelu, ua fasia foi i latou i le fasi tele i Kipeona; ua tuliloa atu ia te i latou i le ala e alu ae i Peteorana; ua fasi ia te i latou e oo i Aseka ma Maketa.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as they fled from before Israel, and were in the going down to Beth-horon, that the LORD cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah, and they died: they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword.
verses.sm: Ua sosola i latou i luma o Isaraelu, na i ai i latou i le ifo aʻi i Peteorana, ona lafo ifo lea e le ALII 0 maa tetele mai le lagi i o latou luga e oo i Aseka, ua oti ai i latou; e toatele o e ua oti i uato‘a i e na fasia e le fanauga a Isaraelu i le pelu.

verses.en: Then spake Joshua to the LORD in the day when the LORD delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon; and thou, Moon, in the valley of Ajalon.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o Iosua i le Atn i le aso na tuuina mai ai e le ALII O sa Amori i luma o le fanauga a Isaraelu, ua faapea atu i luma o Isaraelu, Le la e, ia tumau oe i luga o Kipeona; ma oe le masina i luga o le vanu o Ailona.

verses.en: And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. Is not this written in the book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day.
verses.sm: Ona tumau ai lea o le la, sa tu foi le masina, ina seia tauia e le nuu o e ita ia i latou. E le ua tusia ea lenei tala i le tusi a lasera? Ua tumau le la i totonu o le lagi, ua le vave ona alu ifo, ua tumau pei o se aso atoa.

verses.en: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that the LORD hearkened unto the voice of a man: for the LORD fought for Israel.
verses.sm: E leai foi se aso na muamua pe mulimuli, e tusa ma lena na faafofogaina ai e le ALII le leo o le tagata; aua na tau le taua e le ALII mo Isaraelu.

verses.en: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.
verses.sm: Ona toe foi lea o Iosua ma Isaraelu uma faatasi ma ia i le toagálauapi i Kilikala.

verses.en: But these five kings fled, and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah.
verses.sm: A ua sosola ¡a tupu e toalima, ma lalafi i latou i le ana i Maketa,

verses.en: And it was told Joshua, saying, The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah.
verses.sm: sa taʻua mai ia Iosua, ua faapea mai, Ua maua tupu e toalima, o loo lalafi i latou i le ana i Maketa.

verses.en: And Joshua said, Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave, and set men by it for to keep them:
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o Iosua, Ia fuli ane ni maa telele i le gutu o le ana, ma tuu ai ni tagata e leoleo ia te i latou.

verses.en: And stay ye not, but pursue after your enemies, and smite the hindmost of them; suffer them not to enter into their cities: for the LORD your God hath delivered them into your hand.
verses.sm: A o outou, aua ne“ nonofo outou, a ia tuliloa atu i e ita ia te outou, ma fafasi i e o mulimuli, aua neʻi tuu atu i latou e oia latou aai; auā ua tuuina mai i latou e le ALII lo outou Atua i o outou lima.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they were consumed, that the rest which remained of them entered into fenced cities.
verses.sm: Ua uma ona fasia i latou e Iosua ma le fanauga a Isaraelu i le fasi e matuā tele lava, ua faaumatia i latou; a o e na sao o i latou na oatu i latou i aai nofo ‘olo.

verses.en: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace: none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.
verses.sm: Ona toe foi mai lea o le nuu uma ia losua i le toagālauapi i Maketa ua soagalemu, ua leai se tasi e faagaoioi lona laulaufaiva i se tasi o le fanauga a Isaraelu.

verses.en: Then said Joshua, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring out those five kings unto me out of the cave.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o Iosua, Ina to ese ia o taa i le gutu o le ana, ma au mai ia te au mai le ana o ia tupu e toalima.

verses.en: And they did so, and brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.
verses.sm: Ua faapea foi ona latou faia, ua au mai ia te ia mai le ana o ia tupu e toalima, o le tupu o Ierusalema, o le tupu o Heperona, o le tupu o laremuta, O le tupu o Lakisa, o le tupu o Ekelona.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when they brought out those kings unto Joshua, that Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said unto the captains of the men of war which went with him, Come near, put your feet upon the necks of these kings. And they came near, and put their feet upon the necks of them.
verses.sm: Ua au mai e i latou o ia tupu ia Iosua, ona valaau atu lea o Iosua i tagata uma o Isaraelu, ua faapea atu i e avea “au o le taua, o e na o faatasi ma ia, Ina faalatalata mai ia, ma soli i ua o ia tupu i o outou vae. Ona latou faalatalata mai ai lea, ma latou soli i o latou ua i o latou vae.

verses.en: And Joshua said unto them, Fear not, nor be dismayed, be strong and of good courage: for thus shall the LORD do to all your enemies against whom ye fight.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu foi Iosua ia te i latou, Aua tou te fefefe, aua foi tou te matatau, ia outou malolosi, ma ia loto tetele; aua e faapea lava ona faia e le ALII i e ita mai uma lava ia te outou, tou te tau ma i latou.

verses.en: And afterward Joshua smote them, and slew them, and hanged them on five trees: and they were hanging upon the trees until the evening.
verses.sm: E mulimuli ane ua taia i latou e Iosua, ma fasiotia, ma faatautau ia te i latou i laau e lima; ona tautau lea o i latou i laau ua oo i le auau.

verses.en: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun, that Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid, and laid great stones in the cave's mouth, which remain until this very day.
verses.sm: Ua oo i le itu aso e goto ai le la, ona fai atu ai lea o Iosua, ona ave ifo ai lea o i latou ai laau, ma lafo ia te i latou i le ana na latou lalafi ai; ua latou avane foi maa tetele i le gutu o le ana, e oo lava i le aso nei.

verses.en: And that day Joshua took Makkedah, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof he utterly destroyed, them, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain: and he did to the king of Makkedah as he did unto the king of Jericho.
verses.sm: O le aso lava lea na maua e Iosua o Maketa, ma fasia i le pelu, ua faaumatia foi e ia lona tupu, o i latou, ma tagata uma sa i ai, ua le faatoe e ia se tasi; ua faia e ia i le tupu O Maketa e pei ona faia e ia i le tupu o Ieriko.

verses.en: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, unto Libnah, and fought against Libnah:
verses.sm: Ona o lea o Iosua ma Isaraelu uma faatasi ma ia nai Maketa i Lipena; ona latou tau ai lea ma Lipena.

verses.en: And the LORD delivered it also, and the king thereof, into the hand of Israel; and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain in it; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho.
verses.sm: Ua tuuina mai foi e le ALII lea aai ma lona tupu i lima o Isaraelu; ua fasia ai i le pelu, ma tagata uma sa i ai; ua le faatoeina ai e ia se tasi; ua faia foi e ia i lona tupu e pei ona faia e ia ile tupu o Ieriko.

verses.en: And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, unto Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it:
verses.sm: Ona o lea o Iosua ma Isaraelu uma faatasi ma ia nai Lipena i Lakisa, ma to lauapi i ai, ma tau ai le tana.

verses.en: And the LORD delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, which took it on the second day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein, according to all that he had done to Libnah.
verses.sm: Ua tuuina mai foi e le ALII o Lakisa i lima o Isaraelu, ua latou aea foi i le aso lua, ua fasia i le pelu, ma tagata uma sa i ai, e pei o mea uma na faia e ia i Lipena.

verses.en: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.
verses.sm: Ona alu ae lea o Orama le tupu o Kasera e fesoasoani ia Lakisa; ua fasia foi e Iosua o ia ma lona nuu, ua le faatoeina e ¡a se tasi mo la.

verses.en: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon, and all Israel with him; and they encamped against it, and fought against it:
verses.sm: Ua o foi Iosua ma Isaraelu uma faatasi ma ia nai Lakisa i Ekelona, ma to lauapi i ai, ma tau ai le taua.

verses.en: And they took it on that day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.
verses.sm: Ua aea ai foi e i latou i lea aso, ma latou fasia i le pelu, ua faaumatia e ia i lea aso o tagata uma sa i ai, e pei o mea uma na faia e ia i Lakisa.

verses.en: And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, unto Hebron; and they fought against it:
verses.sm: Ona alu ae lea o Iosua ma Isaraelu uma faatasi ma ia nai Ekelona Heperona, ma tau ai le taua.

verses.en: And they took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof, and all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but destroyed it utterly, and all the souls that were therein.
verses.sm: Ua latou aea ai, ma fasia i le pelu, ma lona tupu, ma ona aai uma, ma tagata uma sa i ai; ua le faatoe e ia se tasi, e pei o mea uma na faia e ia i Ekelona, ua faaumatia e ia, atoa ma tagata uma sa i ai.

verses.en: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and fought against it:
verses.sm: Ona toe foi mai lea o Iosua ma Isaraelu uma faatasi ma ia i Tiperi, ma tau ai le taua.

verses.en: And he took it, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining: as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to the king thereof; as he had done also to Libnah, and to her king.
verses.sm: Ona maua ai lea e ia, ma lona tupu, ma ona aai uma; ua fasia i latou i le pelu, ma faaumatia tagata uma sa i ai, ua le faatoe e ia se tasi; e pei ona faia e ia i Heperona, ua faapea foi ona faia e ia i Tiperi ma lona tupu; e pei ona faia foi e ia i Lipena ma lona tupu.

verses.en: So Joshua smote all the country of the hills, and of the south, and of the vale, and of the springs, and all their kings: he left none remaining, but utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the LORD God of Israel commanded.
verses.sm: Ua fasia e Iosua o nuu uma o i le atu mauga, ma le itu i toga, ma le nuu maulalo, ma le eleele laugatasi, ma o latou tupu uma; ua le faatoe e ia se tasi; a ua faaumatia o mea ola uma, e pei ona poloai mai ai le ALII le Atua o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And Joshua smote them from Kadesh-barnea even unto Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even unto Gibeon.
verses.sm: Ua fasia i latou e Iosua e afua mai i Katesapanea e 00 atu i Kasa, ma le nuu uma o Kosena e oo atu i Kipeona.

verses.en: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time, because the LORD God of Israel fought for Israel.
verses.sm: O ia tupu uma ma o latou laueleele na maua e losua i le taua e tasi; aua o le ALII le Atua o Isaraelu na tau e la le taua mo Isaraelu.

verses.en: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.
verses.sm: Ona toe foi mai ai lea o Iosua ma Isaraelu uma faatasi ma ia i le toagālauapi i
